$comment: Tests written ahead of their feature: each must FAIL until the feature is in, then come off this list. See tests/README.md (red first). Only new tests belong here; the floor guard refuses an existing test listed as pending.

pending.test: a key maps to its room until the room is disposed
a player who leaves a waiting table takes their key out of the index
a restore token is a UUID, not a timestamp anyone could guess
Fly's own client-ip header wins over a forwarded list anyone can write
no response names the framework in x-powered-by, and every one says nosniff
/rejoin answers no-store, so no cache ever hands a seat back
the 11th /rejoin within a minute from one address is refused with 429 and a Retry-After
